items.title: Local Noetherianness is unchanged by base change along a finitely generated field extension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a scheme X over a field k and a finitely generated field extension k'/k, the lemma shows that X is locally Noetherian exactly when its base change is (statement lines 2314-2321). The proof reduces to the affine case using locality of the Noetherian property, arriving at the statement that A is Noetherian if and only if k' tensor_k A is; the forward direction is the standard behaviour of Noetherian rings under a field extension, and the converse is descent of Noetherianness along the faithfully flat map to the tensor product (proof lines 2323-2332). The claim is H2: a locality reduction plus the two directions of the tensor product statement, each a single cited input, with the finite generation hypothesis used precisely for the forward direction.
